entries.title: Luke 23:1
segments: ¶Then the whole multitude of them arose and led Him to Pilate.

entries.title: Luke 23:2
segments: And they began to accuse Him, saying, "We found this [fellow] perverting the nation, and forbidding to pay taxes to Caesar, saying that He Himself is Christ, a King."

entries.title: Luke 23:3
segments: Then Pilate asked Him, saying, "Are You the King of the Jews?" He answered him and said, "[It is as] you say."

entries.title: Luke 23:4
segments: So Pilate said to the chief priests and the crowd, "I find no fault in this Man."

entries.title: Luke 23:5
segments: But they were the more fierce, saying, "He stirs up the people, teaching throughout all Judea, beginning from Galilee to this place."

entries.title: Luke 23:6
segments: When Pilate heard of Galilee, he asked if the Man were a Galilean.

entries.title: Luke 23:7
segments: And as soon as he knew that He belonged to Herod's jurisdiction, he sent Him to Herod, who was also in Jerusalem at that time.

entries.title: Luke 23:8
segments: Now when Herod saw Jesus, he was exceedingly glad; for he had desired for a long [time] to see Him, because he had heard many things about Him, and he hoped to see some miracle done by Him.

entries.title: Luke 23:9
segments: Then he questioned Him with many words, but He answered him nothing.

entries.title: Luke 23:10
segments: And the chief priests and scribes stood and vehemently accused Him.

entries.title: Luke 23:11
segments: Then Herod, with his men of war, treated Him with contempt and mocked [Him], arrayed Him in a gorgeous robe, and sent Him back to Pilate.

entries.title: Luke 23:12
segments: That very day Pilate and Herod became friends with each other, for previously they had been at enmity with each other.

entries.title: Luke 23:13
segments: ¶Then Pilate, when he had called together the chief priests, the rulers, and the people,

entries.title: Luke 23:14
segments: said to them, "You have brought this Man to me, as one who misleads the people. And indeed, having examined [Him] in your presence, I have found no fault in this Man concerning those things of which you accuse Him;

entries.title: Luke 23:15
segments: "no, neither did Herod, for I sent you back to him; and indeed nothing deserving of death has been done by Him.

entries.title: Luke 23:16
segments: "I will therefore chastise Him and release [Him]"

entries.title: Luke 23:17
segments: (for it was necessary for him to release one to them at the feast).

entries.title: Luke 23:18
segments: And they all cried out at once, saying, "Away with this [Man], and release to us Barabbas" --

entries.title: Luke 23:19
segments: who had been thrown into prison for a certain rebellion made in the city, and for murder.

entries.title: Luke 23:20
segments: Pilate, therefore, wishing to release Jesus, again called out to them.

entries.title: Luke 23:21
segments: But they shouted, saying, "Crucify [Him], crucify Him!"

entries.title: Luke 23:22
segments: Then he said to them the third time, "Why, what evil has He done? I have found no reason for death in Him. I will therefore chastise Him and let [Him] go."

entries.title: Luke 23:23
segments: But they were insistent, demanding with loud voices that He be crucified. And the voices of these men and of the chief priests prevailed.

entries.title: Luke 23:24
segments: So Pilate gave sentence that it should be as they requested.

entries.title: Luke 23:25
segments: And he released to them the one they requested, who for rebellion and murder had been thrown into prison; but he delivered Jesus to their will.

entries.title: Luke 23:26
segments: ¶Now as they led Him away, they laid hold of a certain man, Simon a Cyrenian, who was coming from the country, and on him they laid the cross that he might bear [it] after Jesus.

entries.title: Luke 23:27
segments: And a great multitude of the people followed Him, and women who also mourned and lamented Him.

entries.title: Luke 23:28
segments: But Jesus, turning to them, said, "Daughters of Jerusalem, do not weep for Me, but weep for yourselves and for your children.

entries.title: Luke 23:29
segments: "For indeed the days are coming in which they will say, 'Blessed [are] the barren, wombs that never bore, and breasts which never nursed!'

entries.title: Luke 23:30
segments: "Then they will begin 'to say to the mountains, "Fall on us!" and to the hills, "Cover us!"'

entries.title: Luke 23:31
segments: "For if they do these things in the green wood, what will be done in the dry?"

entries.title: Luke 23:32
segments: ¶There were also two others, criminals, led with Him to be put to death.

entries.title: Luke 23:33
segments: And when they had come to the place called Calvary, there they crucified Him, and the criminals, one on the right hand and the other on the left.

entries.title: Luke 23:34
segments: Then Jesus said, "Father, forgive them, for they do not know what they do." And they divided His garments and cast lots.

entries.title: Luke 23:35
segments: And the people stood looking on. But even the rulers with them sneered, saying, "He saved others; let Him save Himself if He is the Christ, the chosen of God."

entries.title: Luke 23:36
segments: The soldiers also mocked Him, coming and offering Him sour wine,

entries.title: Luke 23:37
segments: and saying, "If You are the King of the Jews, save Yourself."

entries.title: Luke 23:38
segments: And an inscription also was written over Him in letters of Greek, Latin, and Hebrew: THIS IS THE KING OF THE JEWS.

entries.title: Luke 23:39
segments: Then one of the criminals who were hanged blasphemed Him, saying, "If You are the Christ, save Yourself and us."

entries.title: Luke 23:40
segments: But the other, answering, rebuked him, saying, "Do you not even fear God, seeing you are under the same condemnation?

entries.title: Luke 23:41
segments: "And we indeed justly, for we receive the due reward of our deeds; but this Man has done nothing wrong."

entries.title: Luke 23:42
segments: Then he said to Jesus, "Lord, remember me when You come into Your kingdom."

entries.title: Luke 23:43
segments: And Jesus said to him, "Assuredly, I say to you, today you will be with Me in Paradise."

entries.title: Luke 23:44
segments: ¶Now it was about the sixth hour, and there was darkness over all the earth until the ninth hour.

entries.title: Luke 23:45
segments: Then the sun was darkened, and the veil of the temple was torn in two.

entries.title: Luke 23:46
segments: And when Jesus had cried out with a loud voice, He said, "Father, 'into Your hands I commit My spirit.'" Having said this, He breathed His last.

entries.title: Luke 23:47
segments: So when the centurion saw what had happened, he glorified God, saying, "Certainly this was a righteous Man!"

entries.title: Luke 23:48
segments: And the whole crowd who came together to that sight, seeing what had been done, beat their breasts and returned.

entries.title: Luke 23:49
segments: But all His acquaintances, and the women who followed Him from Galilee, stood at a distance, watching these things.

entries.title: Luke 23:50
segments: ¶Now behold, [there was] a man named Joseph, a council member, a good and just man.

entries.title: Luke 23:51
segments: He had not consented to their decision and deed. [He was] from Arimathea, a city of the Jews, who himself was also waiting for the kingdom of God.

entries.title: Luke 23:52
segments: This man went to Pilate and asked for the body of Jesus.

entries.title: Luke 23:53
segments: Then he took it down, wrapped it in linen, and laid it in a tomb [that was] hewn out of the rock, where no one had ever lain before.

entries.title: Luke 23:54
segments: That day was the Preparation, and the Sabbath drew near.

entries.title: Luke 23:55
segments: And the women who had come with Him from Galilee followed after, and they observed the tomb and how His body was laid.

entries.title: Luke 23:56
segments: Then they returned and prepared spices and fragrant oils. And they rested on the Sabbath according to the commandment.
